programme.title: Mystery Woman
programme.desc: Amicably divorced from art gallery keeper Elliot McCallister, Samantha Kinsey (who always dreamed of being a detective like her prosecutor's office friend, Cassie,) inherits her uncle's mystery-specialized bookshop. It comes with a mysterious clerk, presumed retired spy Ian Philby. Her former literature professor and true crime author Jack Stenning's adopted daughter with psychic abilities, Tracy, bemoans her father's dismissal of her fear of his writing a book about her nightmarish vision of a ten-year-old murder, which reveals a witness survived. At a party in his home to present the new book, Jack is murdered by a surprise guest who brought a noose to stage a suicide and took evidence from the scene. Jack's estranged son Tom and his boss Lt. Robert Hawke investigate but rule suicide. Although his beneficiary, and claiming she loved Jack despite serial adultery, widow Mary asks the bookstore's would-be-sleuths to prove it a murder and solve it. Shortly after, Sam is the target of a break-in and sabotage.

programme.title: Thicker Than Water
programme.desc: Brand new series: Walter Presents - which showcases the best foreign language drama from around the world - features this darkly atmospheric Swedish series in which a mother reunites her three adult children and forces them to confront the family secrets buried in their past. A beautiful island in the Swedish Alandic archipelago is home to a popular lodge, run by Anna-Lisa Waldemar and her youngest son Oskar. Mysteriously, Anna-Lisa has summoned her eldest son Lasse and her daughter Jonna home - it's the first time the family have been together in years. Despite the idyllic setting, the homecoming is full of conflict, arousing old memories, resentments and secrets. No one knows why they have been brought back and all three siblings are keen for the weekend to be over. However, her children are unaware that Anna-Lisa has a hidden agenda and a plan that is set to change their lives for ever. Starring Joel Spira, Bjorn Bengtsson, Aliette Opheim, Stina Ekblad, Torkel Pettersson, Jessica Grabowsky, Saga Sarkola, Molly Nutley and Tobias Zilliacus. In Swedish with English subtitles.

programme.title: The Forbidden Kingdom
programme.desc: The Forbidden Kingdom (2008) is a kung fu wuxia film directed by Rob Minkoff and starring Jackie Chan and Jet Li. Teenager Jason, who lives in South Boston, is crazy about kung fu. One day he makes an amazing discovery: in one of Chinatown shops he finds the legendary staff which belongs to the great warrior Monkey King. The magic staff sends Jason on an adventure to ancient China, where he joins an army of highly skilled warriors gathered to free their imprisoned king.

programme.title: Farscape: The Peacekeeper Wars
programme.desc: American science fiction series centering on human astronaut John Crichton as the fate of the Peacekeeper race rests on his shoulders. Brought back by the Peacekeeper Alliance, Crichton is their last hope when a monstrous war is waged by the sinister Scarran Empire, and the resilient astronaut must do all he can to protect the people from being destroyed, and the universe from being consumed by the plans of the evil empire. The two-part series follows on from the original Farscape series which, after its cancellation, was left needing to be brought to a conclusion.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Krepšinio klubas Dubajus - Miuncheno „Bayern“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: UFC. Fight Night: Brandon Royval vs Manel Kape
programme.desc: Martial Arts based TV programme. UFC stands for the Ultimate Fighting Championship which is an American mixed martial arts (MMA) promotion company based in Las Vegas that is owned by William Morris Endeavour.The purpose of UFC fighting was to establish the most effective martial art in a contest that had no weight classes and minimal rules that were as follows: no biting, hair pulling, groin shots and eye gouging. Legendary fighters well known for their ability to win in UFC fighting are Anderson Silva, Brock Lesnar, Connor McGregor and Ken Shamrock. Women's MMA has seen Ronda Rousey defend her title from 2012 to 2015 before she was defeated by Holly Holm another belt holder in more than one martial art.

programme.title: EuroLeague. Fenerbahce Beko Istanbul - Panathinaikos AKTOR Athens
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: EuroLeague. Hapoel IBI Tel Aviv - Crvena Zvezda Meridianbet Belgrade
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Vimbldonas. Official Film
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.desc: Reality show follows Dutch-born veterinarian Jan Pol, his family and employees' everyday. Jan Pol and his wife Diane started their own practice in Weidman, Michigan, Pol Veterinary Services, back in in 1981. Dr Pol takes a good care of every family pet and head of livestock no matter what size or condition and is a true legend in the community. Dr Pol has seen it all, treating numerous patients every single day, his daily routine is more than 12 hours but nothing can stop him from being devoted to his patients.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's summer in Michigan, which means time to bale some hay! It's a grueling process, but Dr. Pol, Charles, and Ben manage to mow their hayfield, which is the first step in baling. But a surprise rainstorm could ruin this year's hay haul. They hope for sun, so their crop doesn't spoil before they can bale. Meanwhile, the Pol's bring in their next animal to the farm - an emu!

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's the county fair season! The Pol's plan to get at least two cows and six sheep at the auction, but they have a lot to do before that can happen. First up, they must install a new perimeter fence. Charles and Ben think they are off to a good start, but when Dr. Pol points out how sneaky sheep can be, their workload doubles. Meanwhile, Beth is hoping for a goat at the small animal auction.

programme.title: Land of the Iberian Lynx
programme.desc: Sierra Morena is a mountain range of climatic extremes. The harsh winter puts the lynxes of the Jandula River Valley to the test. Golden eagles, otters, wild boars and cormorants struggle to survive in the land of the Iberian lynx.

programme.title: Dolphins Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: Bertie Gregory is in the Azores, a marine sanctuary and vital pitstop for migrating ocean predators off the coast of Portugal. It's feeding season, as thousands of normally elusive predators join forces to hunt and feed on super-shoals of fish known as bait balls. A vast ocean and battling storms challenge the team for a chance to film the most spectacular feeding frenzy of Bertie's career.

programme.title: Winter of the Bear
programme.desc: In the forests of northern Finland, survival is a race against the seasons. For a mother brown bear, life between winters is a relentless battle as a single mother. She wakes from hibernation, thin and weary, to guide cubs through a fleeting summer. They need food, and she'll teach them everything, not least of all, avoiding dangerous males during mating season and facing wolves in a deadly fight for food. Every day counts in these forests. When winter returns, only the strong and the wise will endure this wild, unforgiving land.

programme.desc: Winter is the most punishing of seasons, a time of year when many animals seek shelter in order to hibernate, but others must face the harshness of their environment. At the auction, the Pol's are hoping to purchase sheep and cows, but the skyrocketing bids threaten their big plans.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The bidding is live at the large animal auction! The Pol's are working towards their goal of bringing home sheep and cows to their farm. Any animals they win will be delivered to the farm in just three days, so the pressure is on to get the sheep hut finished in time - and there is a ton left to do. Meanwhile, Beth and Charles are concerned about the low activity in their beehives.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: This family farm needs a barn! The Pols are ready to tackle their next big project: preserving and carefully taking down a 100-year-old barn since, with every piece they remove makes the barn weaker and weaker. There is no room for error if they are going to transport these irreplaceable beams back to the farm and restore it to its former glory.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pols have reached the most dangerous stage of disassembling the 100-year-old barn: taking down the beams. Then, if all goes well, theyll transport the beams back to the farm. Each part of this process must be carefully orchestrated to protect these irreplaceable beams. Meanwhile, Beth tries training Clovis after he runs away from the farm.

programme.title: Asia's Weirdest

The largest continent on Earth has more than its fair share of peculiar plants and abnormal animals, and this documentary series delves deep into its wild landscapes to reveal some of the strangest species on offer. Expect the unexpected in places like no other, as the series heads to extraordinary locations including the rugged islands of Indonesia and the grasslands of Mongolia.

programme.title: Asia's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Across Asia, young animals are born into a battle for survival and each day brings a new set of dangers. Macaques embark on treacherous journeys to find food. An adolescent leopard struggles while learning to hunt. Though they will grow to be apex predators, Komodo dragon hatchlings flee their cannibalistic elders. The risks are great and the reward even greater: the continuation of their species.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Reality show follows Dutch-born veterinarian Jan Pol, his family and employees' everyday. Jan Pol and his wife Diane started their own practice in Weidman, Michigan, Pol Veterinary Services, back in in 1981. Dr Pol takes a good care of every family pet and head of livestock no matter what size or condition and is a true legend in the community. Dr Pol has seen it all, treating numerous patients every single day, his daily routine is more than 12 hours but nothing can stop him from being devoted to his patients.

programme.title: Cat Wars: Lion vs Cheetah
programme.desc: Caught on tape in Africa's wild Serengeti is a stunning act of violence between two top predators. Three cheetahs are brutally attacked by two male lions - the first time an attack like this has ever been filmed. Now, filmmaker Leo Kuenkel, who witnessed the attack, is trying to make sense of it. Was this a once-in-a-lifetime "perfect storm" event? Or do these iconic African cats have a deep-set, sinister reason to fight to the death?

programme.title: Big Cat Week
programme.desc: RUSSIA'S WILD TIGER records the battle for survival of the big cats and reveals intimate details of their lives. The animals they prey on are also in the film: tigers couldn't survive without sika deer, Altai wapiti, wild boars and Asian black bears. A young tiger, born in a conservation area, will guide the viewer through the film. RUSSIA'S WILD TIGER accompanies him throughout the year after he leaves his mother. His search for a territory reveals the problems facing tigers in Russia's Far East, and the conflicts that arise when he strays into human settlements. The young tiger takes the viewer to places where the fate of Siberian tigers will be decided: vast forests, remote villages and the cities at the edge of the wilderness.

programme.title: Close Encounters of the Wild Kind
programme.desc: Our homes are meant to be safe havens, but wild animals are increasingly showing up uninvited. From bears taking dips in hot tubs to raccoons raiding kitchens and gators on our doorsteps, animals are getting bolder. Are they invading our spaces, or have we taken over theirs? Surveillance footage reveals the surprising ways our wild neighbors are moving in!

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's new livestock aren't potty trained; their sheep hut isn't draining properly and has now been transformed into a Pee Palace. It's late fall and the winter deep freeze is just around the corner, so the family needs to get it fixed fast. The Pol's also get a new sheep for their farm.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol clan gets to work on creating Beth's dream garden. To beat the incoming rainstorm, an exhausted Ben works around the clock to finish building the garden's pond and waterfall. Noticing her brother is near his breaking point, Beth plans a special surprise to lift his spirits.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: A national Geographic documentary looking into the deadliest animals that roam Africa. Examining animals that have evolved complex weapons from teeth to claws and agility so that they can protect themselves and battle effectively. From elephant tusks that can defend or attack to the fur, speed and agility of seals. Showing how these animals have exceptional skills and power alongside their body features that have developed into ideal tools for their needs.

programme.title: Killer Whale Chronicles
programme.desc: Orcas are the rulers of the seas. These majestic marine mammals have captured the hearts of people with their intelligence and complex family structures. However, since killer whales started attacking boats near Gibraltar, many are asking: Are they threatening us or just playing? The central revelation is that orcas, with specialized "cultures," perfectly exploit the richness of the seas. Surprisingly, there are different orca cultures around the globe. This episode also showcases impressive images of how the curious whales create genuine "fashions," and meet for mating. Their family groups are led by experienced matriarchs who maintain lifelong bonds with their offspring, particularly their sons. Singer and orca enthusiast Sarah Connor lends her voice to the documentary, giving the orcas' stories a special depth.

programme.title: Killer Whale Chronicles
programme.desc: A central theme of this episode is the remarkable learning behavior of orcas, passed on from generation to generation. As marine biologist and wildlife filmmaker Florian Graner explores the mysteries of orcas, viewers immerse themselves in the different cultures of the orca populations in the Salish Sea. Singer and orca enthusiast Sarah Connor lends the documentary a special depth with her narration and takes viewers on a journey into the world of the largest members of the dolphin family. The documentary sheds light on the fascinating world of the black-and-white giants of the seas, their intelligence, complex social structures, and their impressive ability to pass on knowledge from generation to generation.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.desc: When Hazel wishes to be 13 so that she can go see a PG-13 movie by herself, Cosmo and Wanda turn her into a teenager. programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish

Hazel must find a way to prove Toothica is no good and get back her gap or be stuck with this rotten tooth forever.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish

But when Dev refuses to participate, Cosmo and Wanda call on the Pe-Az, a trio of alien diplomats, to reason with him. Despite their best efforts, Dev outsmarts the Pe-Az and uses their alien technology to get rid of all the pizza on Earth. // Hazel must take matters into her own hands to get to the bottom of Dev's surly attitude and save pizza! When Hazel makes a wish to understand why Dev acts the way he does, she gets paired with him for a class scavenger hunt. They struggle to work together, but, as the day goes on, they develop a friendship. However, that falls apart when Dev's dad, Dale, belittles their effort, causing Dev to turn on Hazel again to save face. Will Dev be able to overcome his pride and finish the project, or will his issues with his dad tank both their grades?

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: King Me/Private and the Winky Factory King Me: King Julien's archrival, Clemson, returns in another attempt to claim the lemur crown. This time the sneaky lemur has a document that "proves" King Julien is not the legitimate king because he wasn't born in Madagascar. A series of challenges to prove who's more kingly ensues, and the penguins try to stack the deck in Julien's favor by each switching brains with him. Simple, right? How could a plan like this possibly fail? Private and the Winky Factory: Private's favorite treat, the Peanut Butter Winky, is going the way of the dinosaur. Distraught that the snack cake is ceasing production, Private urges a raid on the Winky Factory where the last remaining Winkies are rolling off the production line. Impressed by Private's passion, Skipper gives him command of the mission! The young penguin learns there's a heck of a lot to digest when leading a team. programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Best Foes: Kowalski invents an enemy detector. As is often the case, it doesn't work, and Skipper gets his own wires crossed when he smashes it. Old enemies are now friends and old friends are now enemies as the boss bird starts to systematically clean out the zoo with the help of his new friend Hans. King Julien gets into the act by becoming Skipper's friend too, going so far as to Congaga dance together. New BFF Hans is not happy with the new bromance, however. Could this be the opening the penguins need? Night of the Vesuviuses: The annual Zoo Snooze is here! Kids get to buy tickets for a zoo sleepover, a treat the animals look forward to every year! This year's going to be very different, however, when the rotten Vesuvius Twins buy up all the tickets themselves. The zoosters plan to turn the tables, though, and exact sweet revenge on the twins. The penguins, influenced by Private of course, can't let this happen, and it's a long night's journey into day as the penguins scramble to protect their one-time tormentors.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po the Panda trains, battles, learns, teaches, stumbles, gabs and ""geeks out"" as the newest hero in the Valley of Peace. Now living in his permanent home at the Jade Palace with the rest of the Furious Five, Po will have to take on new responsibilities and face brand-new adversaries (not seen in the movies) in his continuing education as the Dragon Warrior...for being the Dragon Warrior is not a destination, it's a journey (unfortunately for Po, that journey is uphill).

programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: La Liga. Barselonos FC - Pamplonos „Osasuna“
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. programme.title: Ritorno al futuro - Parte II
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo della trilogia di Robert Zemeckis con Michael J. Fox e Christopher Lloyd. Marty e Doc volano nel 2015, innescando una serie di eventi che cambieranno anche il passato.

programme.title: La musica nel cuore - August Rush
programme.desc: Freddie Highmore e Robin Williams in un film toccante e magico. Il piccolo August, prodigio della musica, suona per le strade di New York sperando di rintracciare i suoi genitori.

programme.title: Balto e Togo - La leggenda
programme.desc: Scritto, diretto e interpretato da Brian Presley, film d’avventura ispirato a una storia vera. Alaska, 1925. Nella cittadina di Nome la difterite colpisce i bambini. Con i cani da slitta Balto e Togo, Leonhard e altri uomini del villaggio partono alla ricerca del siero curativo.

programme.title: Shrek Terzo
programme.desc: Terzo capitolo con il simpatico orco verde. Shrek eredita il trono del suocero, ma la vita di corte non fa per lui. Aiutato da Ciuchino e dal Gatto con gli stivali, cerchera' un sostituto.

programme.title: Jumanji - The Next Level
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson, Kevin Hart, Jack Black e Karen Gillan tornano in azione all’interno del videogame. La nostalgia per l’avventura vissuta convince Spencer a rituffarsi dentro Jumanji. I suoi amici lo inseguono per riportarlo indietro, sfidando nuovi pericoli e territori inesplorati.

programme.title: Barely Lethal
programme.desc: Action con Samuel L. Jackson, Hailee Steinfeld e Jessica Alba. Addestrata fin da piccola ad uccidere, Megan sogna un'esistenza normale. Una nuova missione le darà modo di rifarsi una vita.

programme.title: Bla Bla Baby
programme.desc: Commedia di Fausto Brizzi con Alessandro Preziosi e Matilde Gioli. Dopo aver ingerito degli omogeneizzati contaminati, il maestro di un asilo nido inizia a decifrare le urla dei bambini.

programme.title: Sonic - Il film
programme.desc: Jim Carrey e James Marsden, fra live action e animazione, nell’avventura basata sulla serie di videogiochi della Sega. Sonic, un porcospino più veloce del suono, approda sulla Terra per sfuggire ai cacciatori che lo braccano e si ritrova ad affrontare un diabolico scienziato.

programme.title: Alla fine ci sei tu
programme.desc: Asa Butterfield e Maisie Williams in una storia di crescita. Un ragazzo ipocondriaco affronta le sue peggiori paure quando accetta di esaudire gli ultimi desideri di una coetanea malata.

programme.title: Drive Hard
programme.desc: John Cusack e Thomas Jane ("Hung - Ragazzo squillo") in uno sfrenato action ad altissima velocita'. Simon Keller, un famoso ladro americano, ha bisogno di un autista per mettersi in salvo dopo una rapina in banca. Alla fine la scelta cade su Peter Roberts, un ex pilota di Formula Uno, all'oscuro dei piani del criminale. Keller lo assume come istruttore e mette a segno il colpo proprio durante una delle lezioni di guida. Cosi' Roberts si ritrova con le spalle al muro: costretto a usare tutta la sua abilita' per sfuggire alla polizia.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: David Harbour e Milla Jovovich nel reboot del personaggio creato da Mike Mignola. Il supereroe demoniaco Hellboy affronta un'antica strega tornata in vita per scatenare l’apocalisse.

programme.desc: Moderna rilettura targata Sky Original del romanzo di Charles Dickens, con Rafferty Law e Michael Caine. Nella Londra di oggi, una gang di giovani criminali pianifica la rapina del secolo.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Tom Hardy incarna uno dei personaggi più enigmatici della Marvel. Un parassita entra nel corpo di un giornalista dando vita a un'entità metà umana e metà aliena. Nel cast Michelle Williams.

programme.desc: Steven Spielberg dirige Tom Cruise da un racconto di Philip K. Dick. 2054: tre veggenti prevedono i crimini prima che accadano, ma qualcosa va storto e il capo della polizia viene accusato.

programme.desc: Thriller Sky Original - di Peter Chelsom e con Marco D'Amore - sui torbidi segreti di una nota località turistica versiliese.

programme.desc: Thriller Sky Original al cardiopalma con Mel Gibson. Un conduttore radiofonico riceve in diretta la chiamata di un ascoltatore anonimo che minaccia di uccidere lui e la sua famiglia.

programme.desc: Naomi Watts in un thriller carico di suspense. Una psicologa infantile, vedova e con un figliastro paralizzato da accudire, affronta il caso della misteriosa sparizione di un bambino.

programme.desc: Nell'abisso della follia in un horror con Sydney Sweeney e Benedetta Porcaroli. In un convento di clausura nella campagna italiana, una giovane e vergine novizia americana scopre di essere incinta. Le consorelle gridano al miracolo, ma il monastero cela segreti indicibili.

programme.title: Chi è senza peccato - The Dry
programme.desc: Eric Bana nel thriller tratto dal romanzo di Jane Harper. Non convinto dalla versione ufficiale dei fatti, un poliziotto torna nella sua citta' per indagare sul suicidio di un amico.

programme.title: La donna che visse due volte
programme.desc: Il tema del doppio in un thriller diabolico di Alfred Hitchcock con James Stewart e Kim Novak. Incaricato di sorvegliare una donna enigmatica, un detective scivola in una spirale di follia.

programme.title: Vetro
programme.desc: Thriller voyeuristico con Carolina Sala, opera prima di Domenico Croce. Una ragazza che vive isolata nella sua stanza si convince che nel palazzo di fronte si sia consumato un crimine.

programme.title: Magic in The Moonlight
programme.desc: Colin Firth ed Emma Stone in un'incantevole commedia romantica di Woody Allen. Costa Azzurra, anni '20: un mago vuole smascherare una ragazza che afferma di avere poteri paranormali.

programme.title: La donna per me
programme.desc: Commedia di Marco Martani con Andrea Arcangeli e Alessandra Mastronardi. Assalito dai dubbi prima delle nozze, un ragazzo si risveglia per magia senza la futura sposa al suo fianco.

programme.title: Terapia di coppia per amanti
programme.desc: Ambra Angiolini, Pietro Sermonti e Sergio Rubini in una deliziosa commedia sui tormenti amorosi. Viviana e Modesto, entrambi sposati e con un figlio a testa, sono amanti clandestini da lungo tempo ma la loro relazione sta diventando sempre più complicata ai limiti dell’esasperazione. Viviana convince quindi Modesto a rivolgersi a un analista, star di una trasmissione televisiva, per cercare un futuro nel loro rapporto. Ma Viviana e Modesto non sono una coppia, almeno ufficialmente. Tratto dall’omonimo romanzo di Diego De Silva, autore della sceneggiatura con il regista Alessio Maria Federici.

programme.title: Il gusto delle cose
programme.desc: Miglior regia a Cannes alla pellicola romantica di Tran Anh Hung con Juliette Binoche. Francia, 1885: il sodalizio tra la cuoca Eugenie e il gastronomo Dodin da' vita a piatti stellati.

programme.title: Promises
programme.desc: Amanda Sthers dirige Pierfrancesco Favino, Kelly Reilly e Jean Reno in una storia d’amore che rincorre il tempo, tratta da un suo romanzo. La vita di un uomo, padre di famiglia dal passato difficile, viene travolta dall’incontro con una donna in procinto di sposarsi.

programme.title: Big Wedding
programme.desc: Commedia con Robert De Niro, Katherine Heigl, Susan Sarandon e Diane Keaton. In occasione delle nozze del figlio adottivo, due coniugi, separati da anni, fingono di andare d'accordo.

programme.title: Two Weeks Notice - Due settimane per innamorarsi
programme.desc: Commedia romantica con Sandra Bullock e Hugh Grant. New York: Lucy, brillante avvocato ambientalista, viene assunta da un magnate degli immobili che vuole demolire un antico edificio.

programme.title: L'amore, in teoria
programme.desc: Una commedia sentimentale di Luca Lucini con Nicolas Maupas. Un brillante studente di filosofia viene ingiustamente accusato di un reato che non ha commesso e condannato ai servizi sociali, dove incontra Flor, un'attivista che gli cambiera' la vita.

programme.title: Hit Man - Killer per caso
programme.desc: Brillante commedia di Richard Linklater con Glen Powell. Un docente collabora con la polizia fingendosi un sicario, ma un giorno infrange il protocollo.

programme.title: Tutti in piedi
programme.desc: Franck Dubosc e Alexandra Lamy in una commedia romantica. Jocelyn, dongiovanni impenitente, non si ferma davanti a niente quando vuole sedurre una donna. Egoista e bugiardo, finge di essere disabile per conquistare la bella Marie. La messa in scena del playboy si complica pero' quando la donna gli presenta sua sorella Florence, la quale e' costretta veramente a vivere su una sedia a rotelle. Jocelyn dovra' fare i conti con un aspetto da lui sempre trascurato, il sentimento, quello che inizia a provare per Florence. Diretto dallo stesso Franck Dubosc, al suo esordio dietro la macchina da presa.

programme.title: Sogno di una notte di mezza età
programme.desc: Irriverente commedia con Gerard Depardieu, diretta e interpretata da Daniel Auteuil. Un uomo sposato, dalla fervida immaginazione, inizia a fantasticare sulla giovane fidanzata dell'amico.

programme.title: Lei mi parla ancora
programme.desc: Pupi Avati dirige Renato Pozzetto e un grande cast nel film Sky Original ispirato al romanzo di Giuseppe Sgarbi. Dopo la morte della moglie, un uomo ripercorre la storia d'amore di una vita.

programme.title: Cinquanta sfumature di grigio
programme.desc: Eros e romanticismo per Dakota Johnson e Jamie Dornan, dal romanzo di E. L. James. Una studentessa viene sedotta da un uomo ricco e misterioso, che la coinvolge in un rapporto trasgressivo.

programme.title: Il gusto delle cose
programme.desc: Miglior regia a Cannes alla pellicola romantica di Tran Anh Hung con Juliette Binoche. Francia, 1885: il sodalizio tra la cuoca Eugenie e il gastronomo Dodin da' vita a piatti stellati.

programme.title: Romeo é Giulietta
programme.desc: Giovanni Veronesi dirige una commedia con Sergio Castellitto, Pilar Fogliati e Margherita Buy. Per ottenere la parte e dimostrare il suo talento, una giovane attrice si traveste da uomo.

programme.title: Hit Man - Killer per caso
programme.desc: Brillante commedia di Richard Linklater con Glen Powell. Un docente collabora con la polizia fingendosi un sicario, ma un giorno infrange il protocollo.

programme.title: Sogno di una notte di mezza età
programme.desc: Irriverente commedia con Gerard Depardieu, diretta e interpretata da Daniel Auteuil. Un uomo sposato, dalla fervida immaginazione, inizia a fantasticare sulla giovane fidanzata dell'amico.

programme.title: Emma
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Jane Austen, una storia di intese amorose con Gwyneth Paltrow. 1800: una giovane aristocratica inglese aiuta una ragazza timida a trovare l'uomo giusto. Oscar alle musiche.

programme.title: Vicino all’orizzonte
programme.desc: Dal bestseller di Jessica Koch, un teen-movie ispirato a una storia vera con Luna Wedler e Jannik Schumann. Un oscuro segreto rende impossibile il legame fra Jessica e l'affascinante Danny.

programme.title: Matrimonio con sorpresa
programme.desc: Commedia targata HBO. Un imbroglione seduce la figlia di un senatore degli Stati Uniti per impadronirsi dei fondi del padre. Dopo il matrimonio si accorge pero' che ne e' davvero innamorato.

programme.title: A cena da amici
programme.desc: Dennis Quaid e Andie MacDowell in un film di Norman Jewison sull'autenticità del rapporto di coppia. Il matrimonio di Gabe e Karen entra in crisi quando due loro amici si separano.

programme.title: Victor Victoria
programme.desc: Oscar alla colonna sonora per la commedia di Blake Edwards con Julie Andrews. Parigi, anni 30: una cantante ottiene una scrittura fingendo di essere un uomo che si traveste da donna.

programme.title: Nove lune e mezza
programme.desc: Michela Andreozzi dirige e interpreta una commedia con Claudia Gerini e Giorgio Pasotti. Livia accetta di fungere da madre surrogata per co della sorella, all'insaputa dei rispettivi fidanzati.

programme.title: Cafe' Society
programme.desc: Commedia di Woody Allen con Jesse Eisenberg, Kristen Stewart e Steve Carell. Anni '30: il giovane Bobby parte per Los Angeles in cerca di fortuna nel cinema e si innamora di Vonnie.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Road movie con Finn Cole e Margot Robbie, amanti in fuga nell’America degli anni 30. La temuta fuorilegge Allison Wells entra nella vita del giovane orfano texano Eugene Evans.

programme.title: Qualcosa di nuovo
programme.desc: Paola Cortellesi e Micaela Ramazzotti in una commedia romantica di Cristina Comencini. Due amiche di vecchia data, e molto diverse tra loro, si contendono l’amore per uno sconosciuto.

programme.title: Il grande Gatsby
programme.desc: Baz Luhrmann (il regista di "Mouline Rouge!") dirige Leonardo DiCaprio, Carey Mulligan e Tobey Maguire nello sfarzoso adattamento, vincitore di due Oscar, del celebre romanzo di Francis S. Fitzgerald, pilastro della letteratura statunitense. America, anni '20: un aspirante scrittore, Nick Carraway, entra nel mondo di Jay Gatsby, un misterioso milionario ossessionato dall'amore impossibile per Daisy: la donna da lui amata e che vorrebbe riconquistare. Nick verra' a contatto con l'atmosfera festosa dell'eta' del jazz che si consuma in illusioni, malinconie e sogni effimeri.

programme.title: Questo o quello: Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano sulla serie Mission: Impossible.

programme.title: Finché notte non ci separi
programme.desc: Pilar Fogliati e Filippo Scicchitano in una commedia romantica tra le strade di Roma. Un biglietto nella tasca di lui farà trascorrere a due neosposi una movimentata prima notte.

programme.title: Matrimonio con sorpresa
programme.desc: Commedia targata HBO. Un imbroglione seduce la figlia di un senatore degli Stati Uniti per impadronirsi dei fondi del padre. Dopo il matrimonio si accorge pero' che ne e' davvero innamorato.

programme.title: Eiffel
programme.desc: Appassionante Sky Original con Romain Duris ed Emma Mackey. Parigi, 1889: l'incontro con una donna amata in passato ispira Gustave Eiffel nella costruzione della celebre torre.

programme.title: Cafe' Society
programme.desc: Commedia di Woody Allen con Jesse Eisenberg, Kristen Stewart e Steve Carell. Anni '30: il giovane Bobby parte per Los Angeles in cerca di fortuna nel cinema e si innamora di Vonnie.

programme.title: Qualcosa di nuovo
programme.desc: Paola Cortellesi e Micaela Ramazzotti in una commedia romantica di Cristina Comencini. Due amiche di vecchia data, e molto diverse tra loro, si contendono l’amore per uno sconosciuto.

programme.title: Book of Love
programme.desc: Sam Claflin in una commedia romantica targata Sky Original. In Messico per promuovere il suo libro uno scrittore inglese scopre che la traduttrice lo ha trasformato in un romanzo erotico.

programme.title: Aline - La voce dell'amore
programme.desc: Valerie Lemercier dirige e interpreta un biopic ispirato alla vita di Celine Dion. Quebec, anni 60: dotata di una voce prodigiosa, la piccola Aline viene scoperta da un noto produttore.

programme.title: Appuntamento con l'amore
programme.desc: Un cast di star hollywoodiane per una commedia sul mistero dell'amore. A ridosso di San Valentino, si intrecciano le storie di coppie innamorate e di single in cerca dell'anima gemella. Persone che si incontrano e si perdono di vista nei modi piu' imprevedibili. Coppie che si sfasciano, altre che si formano, qualcuno incontrera' l'amore della sua vita, qualcun altro vivra' un'avventura fugace, tutto dall'alba al tramonto, a Los Angeles. Dal regista di "Pretty Woman", il film negli Stati Uniti e' uscito nel giorno di San Valentino, incassando al debutto 57 milioni di dollari.

programme.title: Una sirena a Parigi
programme.desc: Marilyn Lima e Nicolas Duvauchelle in una magica avventura su un amore impossibile. Un cantante si prende cura di una sirena ferita, ma cade vittima della sua voce ammaliante.

programme.title: Vi presento Joe Black
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins e Brad Pitt in una suggestiva pellicola sull'amore e la morte. Un miliardario accoglie il tenebroso fidanzato della figlia, ma è ignaro della sua vera identità.

programme.title: Eiffel
programme.desc: Appassionante Sky Original con Romain Duris ed Emma Mackey. Parigi, 1889: l'incontro con una donna amata in passato ispira Gustave Eiffel nella costruzione della celebre torre.

programme.title: Questo o quello: Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano sulla serie Mission: Impossible.

programme.title: Amici, amanti e...
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Ghostbusters" una commedia piccante con due sex symbol di Hollywood, Natalie Portman e Ashton Kutcher. Adam scopre che suo padre (Kevin Kline) ha sedotto la sua fidanzata. Davanti a un simile trauma, il ragazzo si ubriaca e finisce a casa di Emma. I due, amici di lunga data, finiscono a letto insieme e decidono di instaurare una relazione puramente fisica, senza alcun coinvolgimento: ci si diverte ma i sentimenti devono esser tenuti ben lontani. Un reciproco accordo che sembra anche funzionare, ma sara' sempre piu' difficile tenere a bada il cuore...

programme.title: Aline - La voce dell'amore
programme.desc: Valerie Lemercier dirige e interpreta un biopic ispirato alla vita di Celine Dion. Quebec, anni 60: dotata di una voce prodigiosa, la piccola Aline viene scoperta da un noto produttore.

programme.title: Cinquanta sfumature di rosso
programme.desc: Anastasia e Christian, finalmente sposi, credono di essersi lasciati alle spalle il passato, ma un nuovo pericolo minaccia il loro legame.

programme.title: Cinquanta sfumature di nero
programme.desc: Tornano Dakota Johnson e Jamie Dornan nelle avventure sentimental-erotiche tratte dal secondo capitolo della bollente saga letteraria di E. L. James. Christian Grey riesce a riconquistare la fiducia di Anastasia, ma la nuova vita amorosa della coppia sara' minacciata dall'oscuro passato del miliardario, perche' Christian non riesce a disinnescare le sue pulsioni da dominatore. A rendere ancora piu' torbida la situazione ci pensera' l'ingresso in scena di Leila Williams, l'ossessiva ex-fidanzata di Grey, e di Elena Lincoln (Kim Basinger), la donna che inizio' Grey ai piaceri del sadomaso.

programme.title: Appuntamento con l'amore
programme.desc: Un cast di star hollywoodiane per una commedia sul mistero dell'amore. A ridosso di San Valentino, si intrecciano le storie di coppie innamorate e di single in cerca dell'anima gemella. Persone che si incontrano e si perdono di vista nei modi piu' imprevedibili. Coppie che si sfasciano, altre che si formano, qualcuno incontrera' l'amore della sua vita, qualcun altro vivra' un'avventura fugace, tutto dall'alba al tramonto, a Los Angeles. Dal regista di "Pretty Woman", il film negli Stati Uniti e' uscito nel giorno di San Valentino, incassando al debutto 57 milioni di dollari.

programme.title: Un ragazzo d'oro
programme.desc: Sharon Stone in una pellicola di Pupi Avati con Riccardo Scamarcio. Dopo il suicidio del padre scrittore, il figlio tenta di pubblicarne il libro incompiuto scoprendo scottanti verita'.

programme.title: La verità, vi spiego, sull'amore
programme.desc: Ambra Angiolini e Carolina Crescentini nella commedia tratta dal romanzo di Enrica Tesio. Lasciata dal compagno dopo sette anni, una donna tenta di rimettere ordine nella propria vita.

programme.title: Il bacio che aspettavo
programme.desc: Deluso da una donna e salvato dalle donne. Succede ad un aspirante scrittore che rompe con la fidanzata storica e si rifugia insieme al suo cuore infranto nel paese della nonna. Nuovi incontri gli faranno tornare la voglia di innamorarsi.

programme.title: Little Italy - Pizza, amore e fantasia
programme.desc: Emma Roberts e Hayden Christensen in una commedia romantica nel cuore italiano di Toronto. Una giovane coppia di innamorati deve resistere all'accesa rivalita' tra i rispettivi genitori.

programme.title: Una lunga domenica di passioni
programme.desc: Jean Pierre Jeunet dirige Audrey Tautou in un toccante dramma sentimentale. Una donna affronta gli orrori della Prima Guerra Mondiale per cercare il fidanzato, dato per disperso.

programme.title: Quel mostro di suocera
programme.desc: Jennifer Lopez e Jane Fonda in una brillante commedia a tinte rosa. Una ragazza sta per sposare l'uomo ideale, ma l'invadente futura suocera farà di tutto per renderle la vita un inferno.

programme.title: Le relazioni pericolose
programme.desc: 3 Oscar al film di Stephen Frears dal romanzo di de Laclos, con Glenn Close, John Malkovich, Michelle Pfeiffer e Uma Thurman. Una storia di vendetta e seduzione nella Parigi del '700.

programme.title: Gioventù bruciata
programme.desc: Un classico intramontabile che consacrò il mito di James Dean. Nell'America degli anni '50 un gruppo di ragazzi inquieti e tormentati si ribella al mondo degli adulti. Una generazione allo sbando alla ricerca della propria strada, alla ricerca del brivido ogni oltre limite. Golden Globe a Natalie Wood, nel film d'esordio per un allora diciannovenne Dennis Hopper. Uscito nella sale americane a breve distanza dalla morte di James Dean, avvenuta proprio in un incidente stradale il 30 settembre 1955, quando l'attore aveva girato appena tre film.

programme.title: Tartarughe all'infinito
programme.desc: Aza Holmes, sedicenne affetta da disturbo ossessivo compulsivo e ansia, indaga sulla scomparsa di un miliardario, che è anche il padre di un suo vicino di casa.

programme.title: Non odiare
programme.desc: Alessandro Gassmann e Sara Serraiocco nell'opera prima di Mauro Mancini, ispirata a una storia vera. Un chirurgo ebreo lascia morire un uomo, ferito in un incidente, per una svastica tatuata sul petto. Turbato dai sensi di colpa, assume la figlia della vittima come colf.

programme.title: Hereafter
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige Matt Damon e sonda il mistero della morte. La vita di un uomo che parla con i defunti si intreccia con il drammatico vissuto di una donna e di un bambino.

programme.title: Gli indifferenti
programme.desc: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Edoardo Pesce e Giovanna Mezzogiorno nell'adattamento del romanzo di Alberto Moravia. Intrighi e sentimenti morbosi si consumano in una famiglia romana in declino.

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: 4 Oscar al capolavoro diretto e interpretato da Clint Eastwood con Hilary Swank e Morgan Freeman. Un anziano e burbero allenatore di boxe trasforma una tenace ragazza in una campionessa.

programme.title: Per niente al mondo
programme.desc: Guido Caprino prova a riprendere in mano la sua vita nel film di Ciro D'Emilio. La vita di Bernardo cambia drasticamente quando viene incarcerato con l'accusa di associazione a delinquere.

programme.title: Paternal Leave
programme.desc: Juli Grabenhenrich e Luca Marinelli in un dramma familiare scritto e diretto da Alissa Jung. Una quindicenne tedesca giunge a Rimini per incontrare finalmente il padre biologico italiano, confrontandosi con l'uomo vulnerabile e tormentato che non l'ha mai voluta conoscere.

programme.title: La migliore offerta
programme.desc: Giuseppe Tornatore dirige il premio Oscar Geoffrey Rush in un'intensa pellicola. La vita di un antiquario viene sconvolta dal segreto nascosto nei sotterranei di una villa.

programme.title: Cosa sarà
programme.desc: Francesco Bruni dirige Kim Rossi Stuart in un racconto autobiografico sul tema della fragilita'. La diagnosi di una malattia costringe un regista a rivalutare i suoi legami personali.

programme.title: Per niente al mondo
programme.desc: Guido Caprino prova a riprendere in mano la sua vita nel film di Ciro D'Emilio. La vita di Bernardo cambia drasticamente quando viene incarcerato con l'accusa di associazione a delinquere.

programme.title: Sunset Limited
programme.desc: Da una sceneggiatura di Cormac McCarthy, un dramma HBO con Tommy Lee Jones e Samuel L. Jackson. Un professore ateo e un ex detenuto si sfidano sul significato dell'esistenza e della fede.

programme.title: Nightingale
programme.desc: David Oyelowo in un emozionante dramma targato HBO. Sconvolto dall'esperienza in Iraq, un veterano di guerra sprofonda in una crisi mentre attende la visita di un vecchio compagno d'armi.

programme.title: American Beauty
programme.desc: 5 Oscar a un film simbolo degli anni 90, con Kevin Spacey e Annette Bening, diretti da Sam Mendes. Un quarantenne insoddisfatto si invaghisce di una compagna di scuola di sua figlia.

programme.title: La migliore offerta
programme.desc: Giuseppe Tornatore dirige il premio Oscar Geoffrey Rush in un'intensa pellicola. La vita di un antiquario viene sconvolta dal segreto nascosto nei sotterranei di una villa.

programme.title: Ghiaccio
programme.desc: Fabrizio Moro debutta alla regia con Alessio De Leonardis in un film con Giacomo Ferrara e Vinicio Marchioni. Roma: un ragazzo di borgata cerca nella boxe il riscatto da una vita difficile.

programme.title: Paternal Leave
programme.desc: Juli Grabenhenrich e Luca Marinelli in un dramma familiare scritto e diretto da Alissa Jung. Una quindicenne tedesca giunge a Rimini per incontrare finalmente il padre biologico italiano, confrontandosi con l'uomo vulnerabile e tormentato che non l'ha mai voluta conoscere.

programme.title: Ariaferma
programme.desc: Toni Servillo e Silvio Orlando nel dramma carcerario di Leonardo Di Costanzo che indaga il delicato rapporto tra secondini e detenuti, premiato con 2 David di Donatello 2022.

programme.title: Il giorno dell'incontro
programme.desc: Michael Pitt, Ron Perlman, Joe Pesci e Steve Buscemi nella pellicola d'esordio di Jack Huston. Prima di tornare a combattere, un ex pugile di successo ripercorre il suo passato.

programme.title: L'ultimo giorno sulla Terra
programme.desc: Sci-fi movie con Jean Reno e Hugo Becker, opera prima di Romain Quirot. 2050: un planetoide ha desertificato il globo e ora sta per distruggerlo. Paul e' l'unico astronauta che puo' fermarlo.

programme.title: L'ombra del giorno
programme.desc: Giuseppe Piccioni dirige Riccardo Scamarcio e Benedetta Porcaroli. Ascoli Piceno, 1938: un ristoratore filofascista s'innamora della sua nuova cameriera. Ma la ragazza nasconde un segreto.

programme.title: Per il mio bene
programme.desc: Barbora Bobulova, Marie-Christine Barrault e Stefania Sandrelli nell'opera prima di Mimmo Verdesca. Una donna scopre di avere una grave malattia e di essere stata adottata. Per sottoporsi al trapianto che le salverà la vita, deve rintracciare la madre biologica.

programme.title: Anime nere
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Gioacchino Criaco, un viaggio infernale nel cuore della 'Ndrangheta. In un paesino dell'Aspromonte, l'atto intimidatorio del ventenne Leo nei confronti di un clan rivale riunisce dopo molti anni tre fratelli. Luciano, padre di Leo, vive ancora in Calabria ed e' attaccato alle radici rurali della famiglia. Luigi e Rocco, invece, si sono arricchiti al nord: il primo come narcotrafficante, il secondo entrando nel mondo dell'imprenditoria grazie a un giro di soldi sporchi. La provocazione di Leo li costringera' a un sanguinoso regolamento di conti con il passato.

programme.title: Fire Squad - Incubo di fuoco
programme.desc: Spettacolare film drammatico con Jeff Bridges, Josh Brolin e Jennifer Connelly ispirato alle vicende di un gruppo di pompieri addestrati nel combattere gli incendi di montagna. Un pauroso incendio in Arizona sara' la loro tragica prova del fuoco.

programme.title: Questo o quello: Speciale
programme.desc: Quattro pellicole natalizie, che hanno riscosso il successo di pubblico, disponibili su Sky Cinema.

programme.title: Amarcord
programme.desc: Oscar al miglior film straniero per uno dei capolavori di Fellini. Romagna anni '30: l'adolescente Titta vive le prime esperienze di vita, fra sogni, ricordi e personaggi grotteschi.

programme.title: Che fine ha fatto Bernadette?
programme.desc: Cate Blanchett e' una donna alla riscoperta di se stessa in una pellicola di Richard Linklater. Bernadette abbandona la vita da casalinga con la voglia di riappropriarsi delle sue passioni.

programme.title: L'ultimo giorno sulla Terra
programme.desc: Sci-fi movie con Jean Reno e Hugo Becker, opera prima di Romain Quirot. 2050: un planetoide ha desertificato il globo e ora sta per distruggerlo. Paul e' l'unico astronauta che puo' fermarlo.

programme.title: Still Life
programme.desc: Struggente riflessione sulla vita premiata a Venezia. Il lavoro di John May e' organizzare il funerale delle persone morte in solitudine. Il suo ultimo incarico gli farà scoprire se stesso.

programme.title: L'ombra del giorno
programme.desc: Giuseppe Piccioni dirige Riccardo Scamarcio e Benedetta Porcaroli. Ascoli Piceno, 1938: un ristoratore filofascista s'innamora della sua nuova cameriera. Ma la ragazza nasconde un segreto.

programme.title: The Company Men
programme.desc: Dramma sociale con Ben Affleck, Kevin Costner e Tommy Lee Jones. La vita di un agiato impiegato americano subisce un netto ridimensionamento quando perde il lavoro a causa della Recessione.

programme.title: Il seme del fico sacro
programme.desc: Premio a Cannes e una candidatura agli Oscar per la coraggiosa opera di Mohammad Rasoulof. Nell'Iran delle proteste giovanili, l'unione di una famiglia viene messa a dura prova.

programme.title: Il ladro di giorni

Tony D'Amato e i suoi Miami Sharks perdono una partita dietro l'altra, il quarterback titolare e' fuori per infortunio e la giovane e affascinante proprietaria della squadra e' decisa a far fuori il coach. programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
programme.desc: With a little help from Gabby’s imagination, a sparkly toy banana turns into a magical Rainy Day Banana that helps Gabby and the Gabby Cats have fun on a rainy day! They have silly banana snacks with Cakey, make crafts to tell a story with Baby Box, and have an a-meow-zing banana dance party with DJ Catnip. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Cakey sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
programme.desc: The dollhouse is immersed in imaginative Wild West play with Sheriff Gabby, Sheriff Pandy, and CatRat the Bandit. Sheriff Gabby and Sheriff Pandy must safely deliver gold to the bank, but it gets confiscated by Bandit CatRat! They go on an adventure to get the gold back and restore order in the dollhouse.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Xtreme Xploits of the Xplosive Xmas
programme.desc: George and Harold love Christmas, but they feel like it could use some upgrades. So they make a comic about a new version of the holiday: BLISSMAS. Instead of red bows, laser shows! Instead of ugly sweaters, cool capes! Instead of decorating trees, creating tree-bots! The boys take Melvin’s time toad back to convince Santa to incorporate some of their ideas to his new holiday. But they come back to the present to find that their plan didn’t work quite how they’d hoped. George and Harold realize they need to help Santa remember the true meaning of Christmas before it’s gone forever!

programme.title: Tip And Oh: Home For The Holidays
programme.desc: Oh takes it upon himself to introduce Christmas joy to his fellow Boovs. Unfortunately, his well-meaning mission nearly destroys the city.

programme.title: SPIRIT OF CHRISTMAS (RIDING FREE)
programme.desc: Lucky and friends must figure out how to get home in time for Christmas when a falling boulder -- and a serious snowstorm -- derail their travel plans.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Christmas Bonus
programme.desc: \n \t\nWhen Boss Baby accidentally gets mistaken for an elf and sent to the North Pole on Christmas Eve, he mobilizes unpaid elf workers against an old nemesis: that charity-loving hippie people call Santa Claus. Meanwhile, Tim races to the North Pole to get his baby brother back home in time for Templeton Family Christmas traditions.

programme.title: CSI S4 E16 - Getting Off
programme.desc: Season 4 begins with terrific back-to-back episodes involving serial killers (\"Assume Nothing\" / \"For All Our Country\"). There's a new politically minded sheriff in town and in \"Invisible Evidence\" he's ticked off that the CSI's can't get enough evidence to convict a rapist/murderer. Also, Nick and Sara buck for the same promotion. Along the way there are plenty of quirky cases: one involving a museum robbery (\"Suckers\") and one involving a dead juror (\"Eleven Angry Jurors\"). Grissom travels to a small town with plenty of secrets to solve a murder in \"Jackpot,\" Catherine dates a younger man in \"Early Rollout,\" and Sara works a case involving a woman strikingly similar to herself in \"Butterflied.\" There's also plenty of kinkiness in \"Fur and Loathing\" and tragedy \"Bad Words.\".

Also, Nick and Sara buck for the same promotion. Along the way there are plenty of quirky cases: one involving a museum robbery (\"Suckers\") and one involving a dead juror (\"Eleven Angry Jurors\"). Grissom travels to a small town with plenty of secrets to solve a murder in \"Jackpot,\" Catherine dates a younger man in \"Early Rollout,\" and Sara works a case involving a woman strikingly similar to herself in \"Butterflied.\" There's also plenty of kinkiness in \"Fur and Loathing\" and tragedy \"Bad Words.\".

After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Iron Ball
programme.desc: This sports entertainment show brings the best special forces from Iron Squad to take on a new challenge – dodgeball. The 26 players will enter a fierce competition, until a strongest team armed with powerful athletic endurance and mental strength is formed. Witness how they compete in front of the star athletes and legendary dodgeball coaches!

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: 10 Fight 10 Season 3
programme.desc: The show brings Thai superstars, singers, boxers, models and rappers into the celebrity boxing ring. Season 2 features a first ever Thai female match and Season 3 has two Olympics gold medalists competing for the championship. This unique boxing show offers all-round entertainment, with live performances, lavish costumes and real fights with blood!

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: CYCLE AROUND JAPAN Highlights
programme.desc: We explore Osaka, a prefecture known for its great cuisine. We meet a couple who fish for daggertooth pike conger (hamo), which taste great in summer, a farmer growing juicy eggplants, and much more.

programme.title: Rockie and Her Friends
programme.desc: Puppet action show for children. In a distant post-human future where surviving creatures have formed a community, new-breed dinosaur girl Rockie sets out on hilarious adventures with her schoolmates.

programme.title: u\u0026i
programme.desc: This show for kids promotes a greater understanding for people with difficulties and helps develop empathy. With the help of two fairies, the main character thinks about what can be done to help.

programme.title: Video City: Be Kind, Please Rewind
programme.desc: An uninspired filmmaker accidentally time travels back to the 90s at a Video City store, where he meets the woman who will change his life.

programme.title: Ang Babaeng Walang Pakiramdam
programme.desc: Tasha is a woman diagnosed with Congenital Insensitivity to Pain. This condition makes her incapable of feeling pain – be it physical or emotional pain. And because of her condition, she also has no idea how love works. Until she meets Ngongo, a man with cleft palate. Ngongo becomes an instrument who made Tasha feel again, especially the joys of love and pains of heartache. And together, they experience an adventure that they will never forget.

programme.title: Itutumba Ka ng Tatay Ko
programme.desc: Teteng, a single father and assistant to a film director, faces his last days due to a brain tumor. Despite his fear of confrontation, he becomes determined to protect his tomboyish daughter Tintin from bullies. Teteng, romantically interested in Tintin's teacher, discovers his illness and gets involved in a bar fight, leading to Tintin's kidnapping by a crime boss. With nothing to lose, Teteng fights relentlessly, showcasing his strength and love for his daughter until his final moments.

programme.title: Amnesia Love
programme.desc: A guy is trying to discover his true identity after being found unconscious in a remote island.

programme.title: Dearly Beloved
programme.desc: Can second chances deserve happily ever afters? Can love and second chances mend all wounds?

programme.title: In Your Eyes
programme.desc: A woman marries her younger sister's boyfriend in order to give him immigrant status in the US, hoping to keep them together. But while her sister is away studying, this fake marriage becomes real as the two develop feelings for each other.

programme.title: Midnight
programme.desc:
Kyeong-mi (Jin Ki-joo), a deaf girl, works as a sign language counselor at the sign language call center. One night she witnesses So Jung-eun's (Kim Hye-yoon) stabbing and becomes a new target for the Jekyll and Hyde serial killer Do-sik (Wi Ha-joon). It now turns into a silent chase. Jong Tak (Park Hoon), So Jung-eun's brother, a security guard has to protect her sister. On the other hand Kyung-mi's deaf mother (Gil Hae-yeon) can do anything to protect her daughter.

[About]
Midnight is a 2021 South Korean thriller film, written and directed by Kwon Oh-seung. The film starring Jin Ki-joo, Wi Ha-joon and Kim Hye-yoon, depicts a life-threatening hide-and-seek scenario between a psychopathic killer and a deaf woman. The film was slated to release in 2020 but its release was postponed due to the resurgence of the COVID-19 pandemic. Finally the film was released simultaneously in theatres and via streaming media TVING on June 30, 2021. Midnight will be available on iQ.com from 18 September 2021.

[Source: Wikipedia]

programme.title: Iligpit Si Bobby Ortega: Markang Bungo 2
Friends S5 8
programme.desc: It's Thanksgiving, and the gang remembers former terrible Thanksgiving experiences. Chandler tells Monica that he loves her.

programme.title: Dirty Harry
programme.desc: In the year 1971, San Francisco faces the terror of a maniac known as Scorpio- who snipes at innocent victims and demands ransom through notes left at the scene of the crime. Inspector Harry Callahan (known as Dirty Harry by his peers through his reputation handling of homicidal cases) is assigned to the case along with his newest partner Inspector Chico Gonzalez to track down Scorpio and stop him. Using humiliation and cat and mouse type of games against Callahan, Scorpio is put to the test with the cop with a dirty attitude.

programme.title: The Shining
programme.desc: Signing a contract, Jack Torrance, a normal writer and former teacher agrees to take care of a hotel which has a long, violent past that puts everyone in the hotel in a nervous situation. While Jack slowly gets more violent and angry of his life, his son, Danny, tries to use a special talent, the \"Shining\", to inform the people outside about whatever that is going on in the hotel.

programme.title: Friends S5 9
programme.desc: Ross becomes upset when someone at work takes his sandwich from the refrigerator and eats it. Joey finds himself in a terrible mess when he tries to cover for Chandler and Monica's dating.

programme.title: Friends S5 10
programme.desc: Phoebe collects money for the Salvation Army during the holidays. A bored Ross creates havoc in Joey and Chandler's lives. Rachel is disturbed by her date's inappropriate relationship with his sister.

programme.title: Impractical Jokers S3 12
programme.desc: Four friends compete to embarrass each other in the ultimate hidden camera showdown. The guys lose their rhythm while teaching dance class, try to hock tickets to fantastical Broadway plays, and demand a rematch in their sudden death debates.

programme.title: Impractical Jokers S3 13
programme.desc: Four friends compete to embarrass each other in the ultimate hidden camera showdown. The guys host a taste test with embarrassing survey questions, haggle over priceless pieces of junk at a flea market, and tank as attendants at a gas station.

programme.title: Journey To The Center Of The Earth
programme.desc: During a scientific expedition to Iceland, scientist Trevor Anderson (Fraser-- Crash, The Mummy), his nephew Sean (Josh Hutcherson) and their local guide, Hannah (Anita Briem), are trapped in a cave -- from which their only escape is to go deeper, into unimagined worlds, where the trio comes face to face with never-before-seen creatures and harrowing dangers as they race an building volcanic eruption to reach the surface!

programme.title: Wrath Of The Titans
programme.desc: Taking place 10 years after his heroic defeat of the Kraken, Perseus (Sam Worthington) embarks on a treacherous quest into the underworld to rescue his father, overthrow the Titans and save mankind.

programme.title: Justice League (2017)
programme.desc: Fueled by his restored faith in humanity and inspired by Superman's selfless act, Bruce Wayne enlists the help of his newfound ally, Diana Prince, to face an even greater enemy. Together, Batman and Wonder Woman work quickly to find and recruit a team of metahumans to stand against this newly awakened threat. But despite the formation of this unprecedented league of heroes – Batman, Wonder Woman, Aquaman, Cyborg and The Flash – it may already be too late to save the planet from an assault of catastrophic proportions.

programme.title: Impractical Jokers S3 14
programme.desc: Four friends compete to embarrass each other in the ultimate hidden camera showdown. The guys advertise incompetence to a group of agency executives, are forced into dirty deeds as custodians in a mall food court, and tempt their fates by returning to the wheel of doom!

programme.title: Impractical Jokers S3 15
programme.desc: In this one of a kind mid-season finale, Joe, Sal, Murr, and Q face off in special Joker versus Joker challenges. They try their hands at giving palm readings, manicures, and much more in a humiliating quest to avoid facing the ultimate punishment.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory S6 12
programme.desc: Sheldon is accused of sexual harassment at the University and winds up dragging Leonard, Raj and Howard into the fray.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory S6 13
programme.desc: Leonard's car is stolen when the guys take a road trip to a comic book convention in Bakersfield, dressed as Star Trek characters.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory S6 14
programme.desc: Outraged that he’s being forced to work with university nemesis, Barry Kripke, Sheldon faces a crisis of conscience. Howard and Raj spend a thousand dollars on action figures of themselves.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory S6 15
programme.desc: A fight between Leonard and Sheldon drives Leonard to finally move in with Penny – not realizing how the shift will affect Penny and Amy’s living arrangements.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory S6 16
programme.desc: While the guys try to give their significant others the perfect Valentine’s Day, Raj and Stuart throw a lonely people party at the comic book store.

programme.title: The West Wing S1 11
programme.desc: Bartlet asks an expert on India to help with a crisis.

programme.title: The West Wing S1 12
programme.desc: The President is ill before the State of the Union Address.

programme.title: The West Wing S1 13
programme.desc: Bartlet's position on gay rights is called into question.

programme.title: The West Wing S1 14
programme.desc: The President contemplates commuting a federal sentence.

programme.title: The West Wing S1 15
programme.desc: The Supreme Court Justice nominee is wrongfully arrested.

programme.title: Impractical Jokers S4 6
programme.desc: The Jokers are challenged to hold in their laughter during presentations designed to crack them up. Plus, when Joe, Sal, and Murr try to gang up on Q, he turns the tables.

programme.title: Impractical Jokers S4 7
programme.desc: Joe, Sal, Q, and Murr strike out with patrons in a bowling alley and try to force-feed unsuspecting diners. Plus, a surprise visit by Rosie O'Donnell has tonight's loser seeing double.

programme.title: The Carbonaro Effect S4 17
programme.desc: While working in an art supply store, Michael astounds a customer with a framing device, shocks a patron who can't see the whole picture and becomes a piece of art. Later, a woman goes haywire when Michael literally loses his head.

programme.title: The Carbonaro Effect S4 18
programme.desc: While posing as a security guard, Michael turns a metal detector into a microwave, exposes a surveillance operation, and finds himself in the line of fire. And later, a mover is dumbfounded when a woman rises from the ashes.

programme.title: The West Wing S1 16

programme.title: Blood Diamond
programme.desc: Academy Award nominees Leonardo DiCaprio and Djimon Hounsou join Academy Award winner Jennifer Connelly in this action drama from Ed Zwick, the filmmaker behind The Last Samurai. DiCaprio stars as Danny Archer, a mercenary smuggler searching for a priceless diamond amid the chaos of Sierra Leone's civil war; Hounsou (Gladiator), as a desperate father searching for his lost son; and Connelly (A Beautiful Mind), as a reporter searching for the truth behind the trade in 'conflict diamonds.' Forced to confront the brutal human cost of the diamond trade, Archer changes his search for financial reward to a quest for redemption.

programme.title: Body Of Lies
programme.desc: Trust no one. Deceive everyone. When idealistic CIA agent Roger Ferris (Di Caprio -- The Departed, Blood Diamond) is stationed in Jordan after being wounded in Iraq, he dedicates his life to stopping further attacks by Al Qaeda. Following a plan that the British employed successfully against the Nazis, Ferris plants the suspicion among the terrorists that their leaders are collaborating with the Americans. programme.title: Inception
programme.desc: Your mind is the scene of the crime. Box-office superstar Leonardo DiCaprio stars in this contemporary science fiction action film set \"within the architecture of the mind.\" Written, directed and produced by Oscar and Golden Globe nominee Christopher Nolan (The Dark Knight, Batman Begins, The Prestige), this eagerly awaited follow-up to 2008's billion-dollar blockbuster is yet another visionary tale from a startingly original filmmaker who continually raises the bar with every film he makes. Shooting in London, Paris, Tangiers, Calgary and Los Angeles, Nolan's mind-bending film also stars Academy Award winners Michael Caine and Marion Cotillard, in addition to Juno's Ellen Page, Batman Begins' Cillian Murphy and Oscar nominees Ken Watanabe (The Last Samurai) and Tom Berenger (Platoon).
